scene: an open sketchbook lying on a low concrete wall beside still canal water, a soft graphite drawing of a brick bridge arch on the right page, the left page blank and dented, a ballpoint pen laid in the gutter of the spine, overcast grey light

a wide shallow bowl of thick orange soup on a scratched steel kitchen bench, coarse black pepper on the surface, a folded tea towel behind it, a chipped enamel pan just out of focus at the edge, one warm bulb overhead
a small dented vacuum flask standing open on a kitchen bench with its lid lying on its side in a ring of spilled liquid, a folded tea towel and two unmatched mugs behind, hard flash from close range

the top of a tall grey classroom storage cupboard seen from below, a single pigeon standing at the far end among stacked paper trays and a roll of sugar paper, strip lighting flaring, ceiling tiles above
a heavy fire door propped open with a leaning stack of A3 folders on a scuffed vinyl floor, a corridor of lockers beyond, a bent door closer arm above, flat institutional light
a single grey barred feather lying on a paint-splashed wooden desk beside a chipped mug of brushes and a curled worksheet, low afternoon light from a window on the left

a printed shift rota folded into thirds and flattened out on a bare kitchen table, a grid of four weeks with pencil crosses on some squares, a stub of pencil beside it and an open biscuit tin at the top edge
a dark green wool coat draped over the back of a bentwood chair on a market floor, one sleeve hanging, a hanger and a price ticket on the seat, cold daylight from a high window
the round pressure gauge on a white wall-mounted boiler, red needle sitting well below the green band, dusty pipework and a plastic filling loop below, phone flash on white enamel
